name: cheathub
description: Web app for organizing code snippets, with Flask/Python backend, with React/Typescript frontend

paragraphs: The project is a clean monorepo. The backend serves the frontend, frontend calls the backend, backend writes to db, so on. They are standalone apps to the extent that their variables do not depend on each other. (Right now, they do).
It is written with a Flask/Python restful backend API, a database driver to MongoDB Atlas, and a React/Typescript CRA frontend.
Scripts in root package.json implement Yarn workspaces only to run development-specific scripts from root assuming all backend/frontend-specific configs have been set up.
